caregiversRemain: Other caregivers remain. Transfer family administration or revoke their access in Caregiver settings before deleting your account.
helloSub: Small moments of care make up your family's day.
welcome: A cozy nest for your family
welcomeSub: Record your child’s day and share everyday care with your family.
setupSub: Authentication is not connected yet. You can start here once setup is complete.
providerUnavailable: This sign-in provider is still being connected.
onboard: Welcome. Let's start your family story
onboardSub: Tell us your child’s name and date of birth.
consent: I understand family records are shared according to caregiver permissions.
consentHelp: Family records are separate from public posts. Do not enter real personal information in this development version.
emptySub: Let's start with one small moment.
noTasksSub: Add something here whenever you need to prepare.
noEventsSub: Add a medical visit or a family plan.
quickRecordSub: Keep your family up to date with the latest care.
title: Title
amountOptional: Choose the amount actually consumed, or Unknown if you do not know.
breastDurationOnly: Direct breastfeeding is recorded by time, without estimating milk intake.
author: Recorded by
readonly: You have view-only access to this child. Ask a caregiver with edit access to make changes.
inviteSub: Share only the selected child's records. The link holder signs in and confirms the invitation before joining.
inviteExpiry: Expires in 7 days. Share only with a trusted caregiver.
inviteBefore: Accepting shares the invited child's records with you. Confirm that you are the intended caregiver before joining.
linkHelp: Connect another social account while keeping the same family records. Authenticate with the account you want to connect.
lastIdentity: You cannot disconnect your last sign-in method.
servicesSub: Choose what your family needs, at your own pace.
contentPendingSub: Check official websites for current requirements and deadlines. Unreviewed guidance is not presented as confirmed information.
externalNote: Record application progress yourself after visiting the official website. Opening a link does not complete an application.
prepSub: Keep checklists and notes that fit your family's needs.
errorGeneric: We couldn't finish that. Check your input and connection, then try again.
errorInvalid: Please check the information you entered.
errorConflict: Another caregiver changed this record. Review the latest version before saving again.
errorInvite: This invitation expired, was used or was revoked. Please request a new one.
errorAuth: Sign-in wasn't completed. You can retry after cancelling or declining consent.
errorTimer: A timer is already running. Stop it before starting another.
helpBody: A shared day matters more than a perfect day. Record only what you need.
reauth: Sign in again to continue. Verification is valid for five minutes.
linkConfirm: Link this sign-in method to your current account?
unlinkConfirm: Unlink this sign-in method from your current account?
errorSleepRunning: This child already has an active sleep timer. Open the sleep records.
errorSleepOverlap: This time overlaps another sleep record. Check the start and duration.
residenceHelp: Your family shares this area information. It is saved for future local service guidance.
residenceOwnerOnly: The family owner can change the residence.
residenceGlobalHelp: Save your country now. City and neighborhood selection will be available as regional catalogues are added.
residenceSelectHelp: Choose a legal locality. Only your neighborhood is saved, without a street address.
residenceRemovalPending: Save to remove the registered residence.
